name: Insurgency: Sandstorm
description: Hardcore tactical FPS with intense close-quarters combat. Dedicated server installed via SteamCMD (anonymous).

variables.label: Startup scenario
variables.description: Travel string Scenario_<Map>_<Mode>_<Faction>, e.g. Scenario_Farmhouse_Checkpoint_Security or Scenario_Crossing_Push_Security.

notes: Server name, passwords, rcon and map cycle are configured in Insurgency/Saved/Config/LinuxServer/Game.ini (WindowsServer on Windows) plus -hostname/-password launch args; a MapCycle.txt can be referenced with -MapCycle. A GameStats token (from the official website) is optional and only needed for stats-enabled servers. Windows hosts: set the start command override to Insurgency\Binaries\Win64\InsurgencyServer.exe with the same arguments.
